newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean export regs. 8.7 mln tns by July 31.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean export regs. 8.7 mln tns by July 31.

text.p: Brazil registered 8.69 million tonnes of soybeans for export by July 31, according to government figures released by the Brazilian Association of Vegetable Oils Industries (Abiove).
This was up sharply from 3.59 million tonnes at the same time last year, it said.
Export registrations for soymeal totalled 9.18 million tonnes and for soyoil they were 956,000 tonnes, according to figures from the state export department Secex.
All figures refer to accumulated export registrations since February, which was the start of the 1997/98 marketing year.

Soybean export registrations represented 102.3 percent of Abiove's forecast soybean exports of 8.5 million tonnes this year. This could either indicate that Abiove's export forecast is too small or that some exports will be cancelled.
For soymeal, the amount registered represented 98.7 percent of total forecast exports after Abiove revised its forecast for soymeal exports to 9.3 million tonnes from 8.9 million tonnes previously.
Similarly, soyoil registrations represented 95.6 percent of projected exports after Abiove revised its export prediction to 1.0 million tonnes from 850,000 tonnes.
The association accordingly upped its crush estimate to 18.3 million tonnes from 18.0 million tonnes.
